title: DuckNet backlog groom — independent assessment
description: Output of the groom verify stage. Every claim about the code (stale, gap) and about the backlog (duplicate, grouping) is re-checked by a session that did not make it.

id.description: The finding's id. Exactly one assessment per finding.

verdict.description: holds: checked and true. partly: the observation is real but the conclusion overreaches. does-not-hold: contradicted by the issues or the code.

rationale.description: One or two sentences naming what was checked.

evidence_checked.description: Paths opened, or issue numbers re-read, while assessing this finding.
